research_routes.route: classical cognitive analogy and structure mapping
sources: Gentner, Structure-Mapping: A Theoretical Framework for Analogy, Cognitive Science 1983, doi:10.1207/s15516709cog0702_3
Falkenhainer, Forbus and Gentner, The Structure-Mapping Engine, Artificial Intelligence 1989, doi:10.1016/0004-3702(89)90077-5
Forbus, Gentner and Law, MAC/FAC: A Model of Similarity-Based Retrieval, Cognitive Science 1995, doi:10.1207/s15516709cog1902_1
research_routes.projection: Analogy privileges relational systems and systematic connected structure over isolated attributes; retrieval and expensive structural mapping can be separated because surface cues often dominate retrieval even when deep structure dominates judged similarity.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Represent similarity with explicit relational witnesses; separate candidate retrieval from structural recognition; do not count structure mapping or coarse-to-fine analogy retrieval as novel.

research_routes.source: Larraz and Corma, Human analogical guidance amplifies LLM performance through cross-domain knowledge activation, Nature Communications 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-70873-7
research_routes.projection: With fixed retrieved context, explicit cross-domain guidance strongly changed which available knowledge the model used, demonstrating a distinction between access to knowledge and activation/use of cross-domain knowledge.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Benchmark retrieval, recognition and utilization/transfer separately; a corpus containing the right source is not evidence that the agent can discover or use it autonomously.

research_routes.source: Shen, Druckmann and Zou, Unlocking LLM Creativity in Science through Analogical Reasoning, arXiv:2605.11258
research_routes.projection: Cross-domain analogies built around shared relational structure expand solution diversity and can yield useful scientific solution candidates.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Treat analogy as a deliberate search-space expansion operator, but keep generated transfers proposal-only until target validation.

research_routes.source: Zhou and Jia, Mechanism-Centric Cross-Domain Retrieval for Scientific Discovery, Knowledge-Based Systems 2026, doi:10.1016/j.knosys.2026.116667
research_routes.projection: Mechanistic alignment can be decoupled from topical similarity, and semantic distance can be rewarded to surface cross-domain isomorphisms.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Do not claim mechanism-centered remote retrieval as novel. Replace a single remoteness reward with a typed witness plus multi-objective jump frontier and explicit target-evidence gate.

research_routes.source: Fu et al., GraphIC: A Graph-Based In-Context Example Retrieval Model for Multi-Step Reasoning, AAAI 2026, doi:10.1609/aaai.v40i36.40332
research_routes.projection: Text embedding similarity can contain irrelevant semantics and miss deeper reasoning structure; graph representations of reasoning dependencies provide another retrieval view.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Include reasoning/relational graph retrieval as a replaceable candidate generator alongside lexical, semantic, ontology, equation and causal views.

research_routes.source: Yang et al., MOOSE-Chem: Large Language Models for Rediscovering Unseen Chemistry Scientific Hypotheses, ICLR 2025
research_routes.projection: Scientific hypothesis rediscovery can be decomposed into inspiration retrieval, hypothesis generation and ranking, making retrieval quality a separately testable scientific capability.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Evaluate the source-discovery stage independently from mapping and hypothesis validation; preserve failure localization.

sources: Ghafarollahi and Buehler, SciAgents: Automating Scientific Discovery Through Bioinspired Multi-Agent Intelligent Graph Reasoning, Advanced Materials 2025, doi:10.1002/adma.202413523
research_routes.projection: Ontological scientific knowledge graphs plus multi-agent graph reasoning can expose interdisciplinary connections and support hypothesis generation.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Use ontological graph structure as one local retrieval chart rather than treating graph connectivity as proof of analogy or mechanism.

research_routes.projection: Search, review and figure production are routed as explicit workflows with source hierarchy, deduplication, review-boundary honesty and figure-evidence contracts.
research_routes.rakl_absorption: Use modular workflow routing and explicitly state that same-context role passes are not independent blind review. Keep conceptual similarity figures labeled as non-empirical.

retained_semantic_objects.meaning: A similarity statement is carried by a scoped mapping witness with preserved structure, known broken correspondences, regime, distortion and evidence rather than by a scalar alone.

Same-object/equivalence discovery and distant structural analogy have different error costs and different authority; GLUE may reorganize canonical knowledge, JUMP only proposes transfers until validated.
Candidate retrieval, witnessed analogy, transfer hypothesis and target validation/refutation are distinct epistemic states.
Every domain-stripping abstraction records removed constraints so increased retrieval recall cannot silently authorize invalid transfer.
Deep structure, domain distance, transfer value, evidence readiness, analogy risk and cost remain a multi-objective portfolio rather than one universal similarity/serendipity score.
Multi-hop cross-domain search requires invariant, role, scope and error compatibility at each hop; BRIDGE_TO is navigation, not equivalence closure.

reinforced_not_double_counted: inspiration retrieval as a scientific-agent stage
